def _fit(model, y, plateau=True):
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
    count = 9 if plateau and np.any(model.active) else 7
    cached = None
    d = dp = None
    scale = 1.0

    def evaluate(theta):
        nonlocal cached, d, dp
        if cached is None or not np.array_equal(cached, theta[:2]):
            cached = theta[:2].copy()
            d, dp = model.design(cached, plateau)
            d = d[:, :, :count]
        return d

    def residual(theta):
        return ((evaluate(theta) @ theta[2:] - y) / scale).ravel()

    def jacobian(theta):
        design = evaluate(theta)
        j_tau = dp[:, :, :2] * theta[2:4]
        if count == 9:
            j_tau[:, :, 0] += dp[:, :, 2:] @ theta[9:11]
        return (np.concatenate((j_tau, design), axis=2) / np.asarray(scale)[..., None]).reshape(-1, count + 2)
    tmax = model.t.max()
    low, high = (model.t[model.t > 0].min() / 25, 20 * tmax)
    bounds = (np.r_[np.log([low, low]), np.full(count, -np.inf)], np.r_[np.log([high, high]), np.full(count, np.inf)])
    seeds = np.log(tmax * np.array([[0.065, 0.42], [0.025, 0.28], [0.15, 1.1], [0.3, 2.5], [0.42, 0.065]]))
    best = None
    for seed in seeds:
        w0 = np.linalg.lstsq(evaluate(seed).reshape(-1, count), y.ravel(), rcond=None)[0]
        fit = least_squares(residual, np.r_[seed, w0], jac=jacobian, bounds=bounds, loss='soft_l1', f_scale=0.015, x_scale='jac', max_nfev=100)
        if best is None or fit.cost < best.cost:
            best = fit
    err = evaluate(best.x) @ best.x[2:] - y
    center = np.median(err, axis=0)
    scale = np.maximum(1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(err - center), axis=0), 1e-07)[None, :]
    fit = least_squares(residual, best.x, jac=jacobian, bounds=bounds, loss='cauchy', f_scale=2.5, x_scale='jac', max_nfev=100)
    tau = np.exp(fit.x[:2])
    weights = np.zeros(9)
    weights[:count] = fit.x[2:]
    if count == 7 and tau[0] > tau[1]:
        tau = tau[::-1]
        weights[:2] = weights[1::-1]
    return (tau, weights)
